answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 9 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 740 identities costs 740 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The spiral of the design is public, the glacier of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the pulse of honest work is what finally pays.
